documentation.description:
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 The string util package contains supplemental string handling not included
 with the standard ada.strings.unbounded package.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------

subprograms.name: AorAN
subprograms.code: function AorAN( s : unbounded_string ) return unbounded_string

documentation.description:
return the word s with a leading "a " or "an " depending on whether or
not it begins with a vowel

subprograms.name: basename
subprograms.code: function basename( s : unbounded_string ) return unbounded_string

documentation.description: return the file portion of a pathname string (OS dependant!)

subprograms.name: charIntToResult
subprograms.code: function charIntToResult( result : unbounded_string ) return unbounded_string

documentation.description: convert the first character of result to a signed byte image

subprograms.name: charToResult
subprograms.code: function charToResult( us : unbounded_string ) return unbounded_string

documentation.description: Convert the first character of result to an unsigned byte image

subprograms.name: dirname
subprograms.code: function dirname( s : unbounded_string ) return unbounded_string

documentation.description: return the directory portion of a pathname string (OS dependant!)

subprograms.name: escapeSpacesWithBackslashes
subprograms.code: function escapeSpacesWithBackslashes( original : unbounded_string ) return unbounded_string

documentation.description: Place backslashes in front of spaces (or backslashes).

subprograms.name: escapeSpacesWithBackslashes
subprograms.code: function escapeSpacesWithBackslashes( original : string ) return string

documentation.description: Place backslashes in front of spaces (or backslashes).

subprograms.name: FixSpacing
subprograms.code: procedure FixSpacing( s : in out unbounded_string; inside : boolean := true )

documentation.description:
remove leading and trailing spaces, as well as any double-spaces inside
inside = true to remove inside

subprograms.name: getDateString
subprograms.code: function getDateString( ct : ada.calendar.time ) return unbounded_string

documentation.description:
Convert the calendar time to a human readable string in the format
mm/dd hh:mm:ss

documentation.description: true if string is completely hexadecimal alphabetic or numeric characters

documentation.description: true if string is completely control characters

subprograms.name: Is_Date
subprograms.code: function Is_Date( s : unbounded_string ) return boolean

documentation.description:
true if string is formatted as a slashed date (doesn't enforce
a particular order of month, date, year).

subprograms.name: Is_Digit

documentation.description: true if string is completely digit characters

subprograms.name: Is_Graphic

subprograms.name: Is_Letter
subprograms.code: function Is_Letter( s : unbounded_string ) return boolean

documentation.description: true if string is completely letter characters

subprograms.name: Is_Lower
subprograms.code: function Is_Lower( s : unbounded_string ) return boolean

documentation.description: true if string is completely lower-case characters

subprograms.name: Is_Special
subprograms.code: function Is_Special( s : unbounded_string ) return boolean

subprograms.code: function Is_Upper( s : unbounded_string ) return boolean

subprograms.name: Levenshtein_Distance
subprograms.code: function Levenshtein_Distance (S, T : String) return Natural

documentation.description: edit distance between two strings

subprograms.name: replaceAll
subprograms.code: function replaceAll( str_val, needle_val, newstr_val : unbounded_string; sensitive : boolean ) return unbounded_string

subprograms.name: replaceCSVField
subprograms.code:
procedure replaceCSVField( s : in out unbounded_string; delimiter : character;
f : natural; field : string; allowSingleQuotes : boolean:= false )

documentation.description:
replace the fth field delimited by delimiter (typically a comma) with field
allow the delimiter to be escaped by double quote marks

subprograms.name: replaceField
subprograms.code:
procedure replaceField( s : in out unbounded_string; delimiter : character;
f : natural; field : string )

documentation.description: replace the fth field delimited by delimiter with field

subprograms.name: Soundex
subprograms.code: function Soundex (instr : String) return String

documentation.description: return Soundex code

subprograms.name: Split
subprograms.code:
procedure Split( s : unbounded_string; left, right : out unbounded_string;
width : natural )

documentation.description: gracefully split s into left and right near split position width

subprograms.name: stringCSVField
subprograms.code:
function stringCSVField( s1 : unbounded_string; delimiter : character;
f : natural; allowSingleQuotes : boolean := false ) return unbounded_string

documentation.description:
return the fth field delimited by delimiter (typically a comma) but
allow the delimiter to be escaped by double quote marks

subprograms.name: stringField
subprograms.code:
function stringField( s : unbounded_string; delimiter : character; f : natural )
return unbounded_string

documentation.description: return the fth field delimited by delimiter

subprograms.name: stringLookup
subprograms.code:
function stringLookup( s, t : unbounded_string; delimiter : character )
return unbounded_string

documentation.description:
Treat s (source) as a series of field pairs.  Return the right-hand pair
member associated with t (target), or a null string if none exists.  If
source or target is a null string, a null string is also returned.

subprograms.name: ToBasic
subprograms.code: function ToBasic( s : unbounded_string ) return unbounded_string

documentation.description: convert string to basic (non-special) characters

subprograms.name: ToCSV
subprograms.code: function ToCSV( s : unbounded_string ) return unbounded_string

documentation.description: convert s to CSV

subprograms.name: ToCtrlEscaped
subprograms.code: function ToCtrlEscaped( s : unbounded_string ) return unbounded_string

documentation.description: convert only control characters in string to ASCII codes

subprograms.name: ToEscaped
subprograms.code: function ToEscaped( s : unbounded_string ) return unbounded_string

documentation.description: convert special characters in string to ASCII codes

subprograms.name: ToJSONEscaped
subprograms.code: function ToJSONEscaped( s : unbounded_string ) return unbounded_string

subprograms.name: ToJSONUnescaped
subprograms.code: function ToJSONUnescaped( s : unbounded_string ) return unbounded_string

documentation.description: convert JSON escape codes in string back to actual characters

subprograms.name: ToLower
subprograms.code: function ToLower( s : unbounded_string ) return unbounded_string

documentation.description: convert string to lower case

subprograms.name: ToProper
subprograms.code: function ToProper( s : unbounded_string ) return unbounded_string

documentation.description: convert string to proper (mixed or title) case

documentation.description:
return a string if not running in maintenance mode

subprograms.name: ToUpper
subprograms.code: function ToUpper( s : unbounded_string ) return unbounded_string

documentation.description: convert string to upper case

subprograms.name: TypoOf
subprograms.code: function TypoOf( BadString, GoodString : unbounded_string ) return boolean

documentation.description: 80% of all typos are single insertions, deletions, exchanges, or subs.

Remove escaping backslashes.  If there is a trailing backslash, it is

Remove escaping backslashes.  If there is a trailing backslash, it is
